hypotheses.text: A pass to Kai Nakamura (CM) would have been safer and increased the chance to keep possession compared with the intercepted pass to Felix Ondo.
If Oscar Lindqvist had carried the ball forward instead of passing, he would have reduced the interception risk and improved the chance to keep the ball.
If defender Sami Okoro (CM) had been 5 m closer to Lindqvist, his presence would have deterred or blocked the interception and improved the chance to retain possession.
